..Title
Resolution to Appropriate and Increase the FY 2025 Office of Sustainability and Innovations Climate Action Millage Expenditure Budget by $1,374,210.00 (8 Votes Required)
..Memorandum
In FY 2024, City Council approved the following resolutions, authorizing agreements to be paid from the Climate Action Millage:

	R-23-453 Elevate Energy - Administration of the Residential Rebate Program

R-23-454 Walker-Miller Energy Services, LLC - Administration of the Home Energy Advisor Program

R-24-039 G.O. Williams & Associates, LLC - Circular Economy Planning and Stakeholder Engagement

R-24-071 Stantec Consulting Services Inc. - Geothermal Advisory and Design Services

R-24-084 Sesame Solar, Inc. - Mobile Nanogrid

Said resolutions, however, did not include the language/resolved clauses necessary to roll any unused budgets for those agreements forward for use in subsequent fiscal years causing the unused funds to fall into fund balance at the end of FY 2024; therefore, an appropriation of the unspent FY 2024 funding to the FY 2025 expenditure budget is necessary to fund these contracts/projects through completion.

Budget/Fiscal Impact: Funding is available in the Climate Action Millage Fund Balance.
..Staff
Prepared by: Kim Hoenerhoff, Financial Analyst
Reviewed by: Missy Stults, Sustainability and Innovations Director 
		 Kimberly Buselmeier, Interim Chief Financial Officer
		 Valerie Jackson, Assistant City Attorney
Approved by: Milton Dohoney Jr., City Administrator
..Body
Whereas, Funding in the amount of $1,374,210.00 was included in the approved FY 2024 Climate Action Millage Expenditure Budget for various agreements;

Whereas, These agreements were approved by City Council in FY 2024 via resolutions R-23-453, R-23-454, R-24-039, R-24-071, R-24-084; and

Whereas, Funding is available in the Climate Action Millage Fund Balance;

RESOLVED, That City Council approve and appropriate $1,374,210.00 to the FY 2025 Sustainability and Innovations Climate Action Millage Expenditure Budget from the Climate Action Millage fund balance for the following:

Elevate Energy (R-23-453) - $156,805

Walker-Miller Energy Services LLC (R-23-454) - $142,584

G.O. Williams & Associates LLC (R-24-039) - $56,250

Stantec Consulting Services INC (R-24-071) - $685,571

Sesame Solar (R-24-084) - $333,000

Total = $1,374,210

RESOLVED, That all amounts herein are without regard to fiscal year; and

RESOLVED, That the City Administrator is authorized to take all appropriate actions to implement this resolution.
